fee_notes: Royalty of 6% and Marketing Fund Contribution of 4% are both based on 'Net Sales' (as defined), paid weekly via EFT on Thursday based on prior week's sales. Technology Fee is $395/month per Teriyaki Shop after opening; may be increased upon 30 days' notice, with increases above $650/month capped at 10% annually. Pre-opening technology fee of $99.95/month (up to $900) applies only to first shop and is not captured in ongoing tech fee. Additional ongoing fees include: Grand Re-Opening Advertising $20,000 (upon transfer or relocation); Training/Assistance $500/person/day; Conference Fee $2,000 for up to 2 attendees (annual convention, $500 refunded if required attendee attends, $1,000 per additional attendee); Transfer Fee $25,000; Renewal Franchise Fee $5,000; Relocation Fee $12,500/shop; Gift Card Processing Fee $13/month/shop; Failure to Submit Required Reports $100/occurrence plus $100/week; Interim Manager Fee $500/day plus expenses; Credit Card Service Fee up to 3% of charge.
raw_excerpt:
Type of Fee Amount Due Date Remarks
Royalty Fee(1) 6% of Net Sales(2) Thursday of each week based on Net Sales during the previous week. Payments are made via electronic funds transfer ("EFT") or other manner we designate.
Marketing Fund Contribution 4% of Net Sales Payable at the same time and in the same manner as the Royalty Fee. Payable directly to the Marketing Fund which is discussed in more detail in Item 11.
Technology Fee $395 per month per Teriyaki Shop after your Teriyaki Shop commences operations Monthly on the first Tuesday of each month We may increase this fee upon 30 days written notice to you. Any increase in technology fee above $650 per month shall be subject to an annual cap of 10% of the total technology fee charged in the prior calendar year. Paid by EFT or other manner we designate.
